The '''Pesmenben system''' was located in the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pesmenben IV]] in its fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position.<ref name="CSWE" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] scheme on [[Pesmenben IV]] occurred prior to the [[Battle of Ylesia]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] tricked Pesmenben IV's [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Pesmenben IV)|Imperial governor]] into leasing the planet via a scam that involved [[lithium]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pesmenben [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] roleplaying game source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|issue thirteen]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, which placed the system in the [[Trebela sector]]; however, as the magazine was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The first canonical mention of the Pesmenben system was in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square Q-11,<ref name="TEA" /> and its [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] overrode the ''Voyages SF'' placement by establishing that the Pesmenben system was a part of the Teraab [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
